title.narrative: EU Regional Support to strengthen border security capacities in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: The programme will be implemented by FRONTEX and will contribute to increased implementation by the Western Balkans of EU compliant border security measures by: capacitating WB to operationalise and implement EBCG Status Agreements (outcome 1); improving knowledge and better equipping WB to align their Integrated Border Management (IBM) strategies with EU IBM standards (outcome 2); and increasing WB expertise in setting up fully operational National Coordination Centres
